summary: Audited the current Plan de acción / Universal Control human correction flow against durable intent and current served sources. The durable Page Change Thread + disposable-agent + same-host-return mechanism already exists; the primary UX gap is action compression. Today a correction is captured, saved, separately routed through Trabajar/Pensar, launched into a disposable ChatGPT tab, then returned through result plumbing. The audit preserves note-only capture and authority semantics while defining constraints for a one-primary-action correction path. A non-obvious page-identity ambiguity was isolated: the owner shell uses a fixed Page Change Loop page.id while iframe child location is carried as metadata and navigatePage is a no-op; this mapping should be proven before promising 'this page' correction.

findings.finding: One human correction currently requires separate capture/save and Trabajar commits; preserve save-only notes but add a primary correction path that persists and requests execution in one action.
The entry label 'Notas y trabajo' exposes the storage/work container rather than the human intent to change the current surface. Reuse the same thread, but make the primary affordance intent-shaped.
Pensar vs Trabajar is normally a compute-routing decision pushed onto the human; the ordinary correction path should infer/compile the role and leave explicit analysis-only mode optional.
Result cards expose Ver/Prometeo/Candidato/Publicado as peer actions. Keep evidence/authority detail but give normal UX one primary result action unless a true authority decision is required.

Fixed owner-shell Page Change Loop page.id plus child source metadata and no-op navigatePage creates a page-scope ambiguity. Verify two distinct child pages end-to-end before promoting 'Cambiar esta página' wording.
Unlinked workspace currently falls back to legacy Prometeo implicitly. Prefer an explicit inline linking/recovery boundary with legacy as secondary fallback.

protected_invariants: reuse existing Page Change Thread/Feed rather than create a second message system
worker chat remains disposable and durable return/status remains authority
primary result navigation routes through Universal Host
/wc remains canary until explicit production gates pass

deduplication.reason: Implementation/planning space is already represented by active/prepared Page Thread bridge, Control Surface candidate, Surface Registry, Control Room, Local Steward, control-plan Truth/Intent/Risk/Discover/Plan/Local-Integrate lanes. UX findings should be consumed as constraints/tests by PLAN and LOCAL-INTEGRATE rather than creating duplicate work.

acceptance_handoff: normal text correction can be expressed and committed to work in one primary human action
normal correction does not require choosing Pensar vs Trabajar
normal result has one primary action with authority/evidence details still inspectable
page/thread identity is proven across at least two iframe child pages before page-scoped wording promotion
unlinked-device state explains the real boundary rather than silently redirecting to legacy
no second shell/message system/worker truth store/mutation path is introduced
